title: US markets closed — Thanksgiving Day (the 1:00 p.m. ET early close follows on Friday 2027-11-26)
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200 after its 302 -- the page needs curl -L -- 109,180 bytes) and parsed cell by cell by this session, the same artifact and the same byte count this repo's thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 entry already records. The page states 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028'; its Thanksgiving Day row parses as ['Thursday, November 26***', 'Thursday, November 25***', 'Thursday, November 23*** '] for 2026 / 2027 / 2028, so 2027 is a FULL closure on Thursday November 25, and footnote *** reads verbatim: 'Each market will close early at 1:00 p.m. (1:15 p.m. for eligible options) on Friday, November 27, 2026, Friday, November 26, 2027, and Friday, November 24, 2028 (the day after Thanksgiving).' INDEPENDENTLY CORROBORATED FROM A SECOND, NON-EXCHANGE PRIMARY fetched the same session: the OCC's own 2027 expiration calendar (www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) marks 2027-11-25 an 'Exchange/OCC holiday' with the hatched flag it uses for full closures, and marks no other November 2027 date that way. REPRODUCED A THIRD TIME BY STATUTE AND WEEKDAY ARITHMETIC, computed rather than assumed: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes Thanksgiving on the FOURTH THURSDAY in November; 2027-11-01 is a Monday, so the Thursdays are the 4th, 11th, 18th and 25th, and the fourth is 2027-11-25. The same arithmetic returns 2026-11-26 and 2028-11-23, matching the exchange's own row for both. Filed estimate on the same two counts the sibling closure entries (labor-day-market-closure-2026-09-07, good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26, memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31) already documented: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an exchange's own holiday calendar, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. The DATE is not in doubt -- the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Discovered during the fomc-minutes-2027-11-17 initial research, checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-minutes-2027-11-17 initial research (2026-09-08), and it is the date that lane's entire publication-date argument rests on, which is why it is filed rather than merely noted. THE MECHANISM, stated once so it is not re-derived: FOMC minutes publish at D+21 from the decision in 143 of the 157 releases 2007-2026, and the autumn meeting's minutes -- this calendar's own 2027-11-17 entry -- are the most-displaced class in that record, 7 of 19 (36.8%) against September's 19 of 19 perfect. Every one of those 7 displacements had D+21 landing ON Thanksgiving or on the Wednesday immediately before it; all 8 instances whose D+21 sat further away held at exactly D+21. So the Thanksgiving date IS the release-date rule's only input beyond the decision date, and 2027-11-17 clears 2027-11-25 by 8 days. THE HOLE IT FILLS: this calendar tracks thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 -- the Friday early close -- but no Thanksgiving CLOSURE entry in any year, while carrying full-closure entries for Labor Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, MLK, Presidents' Day and Washington's Birthday. The id follows that class's convention, <holiday>-market-closure-<date>, not the half-day one. TWO NOTES FOR WHOEVER TAKES IT. (1) The Friday 2027-11-26 1:00 p.m. early close is in the same footnote quoted above and is a separate, genuinely distinct event under the thanksgiving-half-day-* convention; it is deliberately NOT proposed here, because one file per finding is the rule and this lane's mechanism needs the Thursday, not the Friday. (2) Unlike the minutes entry that proposes it, this date inherits no tentative chain -- a statutory fourth Thursday is fixed -- so it can promote on its own initial research the moment a lane finds a prefix the taxonomy accepts. IMPACT low matches every sibling closure entry. symbols is empty; a closure removes sessions, it does not signal. Proposed as an estimate; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
